notes.title: Open world features
notes.content:
🌎 «Across the Wilds» open world features:

🧭 Line up the district with local companies and people, that are ready to gladly help you.

🧭 Wild animals that can be hunted in order to cook or sell skins.

🧭 If you are tired of driving and hunting, you can leave this and go fishing. Caught fish can be cooked or sold to the locals.

🧭 A variety of characters will meet you on the following paths. They will tell different stories from their lives.

🧭 Open new routes to update the old map.

🧭 Different weather conditions make it difficult or completely impossible to move on foot or by car in some places.

🧭 Put up a tent, light a fire and enjoy the views.

[b]What else would you like to see in the game? Share your thoughts in the comments![/b]

notes.title: Car upgrades and costumization
notes.content:
🔧 In «Across the Wilds» you can upgrade any vehicle in your garage - from visual parts to technical improvements. These upgrades will make it easier to pass through hard-to-reach places where it was previously difficult or impossible to drive, and the delivery orders had to be abandoned. Upgrading vehicles will make it easier and faster to deliver goods, making your car more resistant to external factors that will be encountered in the game world. It is hard to be ready for all the difficulties at once, so the transport elements can be reassembled for a specific task in order to make the path easier during delivery. But improving transport does not always give an advantage over obstacles. On a mission you as a driver will play the biggest role. Make an upgrade purely for yourself.

🛻 This is how it will look in the game:
1. While fulfilling an order, you got stuck in the mud. You can’t get out cause you don’t have enough power and maneuverability. You have to cancel the order and evacuate the transport. It's time to upgrade the car.
2. You go to the auto repair shop and upgrade the car. Buy and install:
- A more powerful engine that doesn't overheat and break down at high rpm when trying to get out of the mud or climb the mountain.
- A winch - if you get bogged down in the mud, you can catch on the nearest tree or stump.
- New wheels with off-road tires to improve deep mud flotation and grip.
- Snorkel to protect the engine from water entering it while fording, or from dust if the vehicle is used on dusty or sandy terrain.
- External / internal roll cage, so that you don't get squeezed by the car inside if you roll over.
- A deer guard that promotes safe movement over rough terrain and at the same time protects the vehicle engine during a strong collision.
3. After a small upgrade, you can go further to complete delivery tasks. From now on nothing and no one will stop you!

💬 What else should we add to that formula? Share your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[b]❓ When «Across the Wilds» is coming out? [/b]
«Across the wilds» is currently in an early stage of development (as of March 2023). It is being developed by indie studio and planned to be released in 2025. 

[b]❓ When can I play this game? Are you planning to do a beta test?[/b]
We will share our roadmap soon. Stay tuned!

[b]❓ Will «Across the Wilds» be releasing on consoles? [/b]
Yes, we are planning to release the game for PC and consoles. 

[b]❓ Will «Across the Wilds» support co-op? [/b]
Yes, we want to add a co-op mode. In co-op mode, couriers will work under different contracts, get stuck and require the help of friends, without whom it will be problematic to pull out the transport, especially without the necessary tools, winches and strong ropes. 

[b]❓ What makes this game different from Snowrunner/Mudrunner? [/b]
The main difference is that you can get out of the car. That adds a new layer to the well-known off-road gameplay. Also «Across the Wilds» has unique features such as more detailed tuning, character customization, and other interesting stuff, which we will share later!

[b]❓ Will the game have survival elements? [/b]
Yes, in the best traditions of survival games.

[b]❓ Can you build your own base? [/b]
Right now you can’t build your own base from scratch. But you can customize your garage in great detail – it is your base in some sense.

[b]❓ Can you hunt? [/b]
It is in plans.

[b]❓ Will there be any type of enemy NPCs? Zombies? [/b]
Hostile NPCs are planned but not finalized. There will be no zombies. (sorry, DayZ fans😅)

[b]❓ Will there be trailers in the game? [/b]
Yes!

[b]❓ Does terrain deform when driven on or become harder to traverse with the changing weather? [/b]
This feature is currently in discussion. 

[b]❓ Is there manual switching capability? (having to walk out and hook up) [/b]
Yes.

[b]❓ Is there going to be full controller support? [/b]
Absolutely! 

[b]❓ How much will the game cost? [/b]
We are now in an early stage of development, so it is too early to give a price for the game. We need to wait until we have more concrete information about our partnerships and financing before we can announce an approximate price. 

[b]❓ What languages «Across the Wilds» support?[/b]
The game is being created in English, but more languages definitely will be added. We will propose new languages, prioritizing those of the nations that are most seen in our community.

If you have more questions for the team, feel free to ask!
And don't forget to support the game by adding it in your wishlist on Steam!

notes.title: Gameplay details
notes.content:
This is how we envisioned the «Across the Wilds» gameplay loop to look like. And we want your opinion! What needs to be added and what is clearly should be removed?

1. You hang out at the base, tinkering with new upgrades for the car.
2. A new order arrives on your PDA - "deliver medicines to the observation tower on the mountain." You accept an order.
3. You plan a route, collect equipment, tell yourself in the mirror that you are the best and can handle everything.
4. You leave the base to pick up the order.
5. You remember that you forgot the rope at the base. You're coming back.
6. You leave the base to pick up the order. On the way you buy some snacks at a gas station. You pick up the order.
7. You are driving through a wild forest, it starts to rain. You get stuck in the mud. Damn it.
8. You send an invite to a friend - he comes and pulls you out with a rope.
9. It got dark. This was not a part of the plan. You and a friend decide to set up camp. Buying snacks at a gas station earlier was a great idea.
10. Morning. You say goodbye to a friend and drive along with nice music on the radio. Enjoy the views.
11. Oh, look! A moose!
12. Carefully drive around the moose and drive along. 
13. There is a tree in the middle of the road. Damn it.
14. Get out of the car, remove the tree. It wasn't that scary! The journey continues!
15. You made it to the mountain. Congratulations! But the car won't go any further.
16. You climb the mountain for a long time. It's hard!
17. You break your leg, but luckily you have 99 first aid kits in your backpack.
18. Finally you get to the observation tower. You place an order. The customer is satisfied. You get the money.
19. You return to the base.
20. You hang out at the base, tinkering with new upgrades for the car.
21. Several new orders arrive on your PDA...

💬 Feel free to share your thoughts with us in the comments!
And please support the game by adding it to your wishlist:

notes.title: Greetings, Wanderers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574190/ef99e8d2013911bd0c5bdf0da363f4befc96566e.png[/img]
Wanderers!

It's been a very cool month for us since we published our first «Across the Wilds» gameplay video! We've already received a ton of positive feedback! Thank you all for your support! It gives us strength! Now we want to tell you more about our game. 

[h2][b]«Across the Wilds» is a video game that combines off-road driving simulation and courier delivery.[/b]
[/h2]
We like this mix. Traveling, discovering new places, feeling the freedom - it's all part of our worldview! Doing it by car is doubly enjoyable! And what about delivery - it's an opportunity to enjoy going through a difficult challange. We love it. That's why we make games and deliver them to your computer:) «Across the Wilds» is our "first delivery" for you! It's inspiring! 

We've tried to make the usual off-road driving mechanics as realistic as possible, but in a way that makes driving through the dirt fun, not boredom like "Oh my God, when will this end?!". Transmission, suspension, wheels - you can customize it all. You'll be able to customize the car to your own style of play. We believe that you will like it!

[h2][b]Play in single or multiplayer mode [/b][/h2]
«Across the Wilds» offers you to play in both single player and multiplayer. Your friends can join you and progress with you. You will be able to share your resources, machines, quests, explore the world together and help each other in difficult situations. Offer your ideas on what you'd like to see in co-op! Let's do it together!

[h2][b]We're just getting started and are in the early stages of development[/b][/h2]
Right now we are working mostly on the gameplay mechanics and visuals. We have already shown some videos and you can see some of our open world features and imagine the final result. But that's not all of what we want to do! 

We want players to be able to gain experience and evolve in the world of «Across the Wilds» as much as they want. The game's immense world provides endless experiences and gameplay mechanics, and therefore a real pleasure to play.

You will travel during day and night, rain and sun, summer and winter - «Across the Wilds» is a realistic world, where everything will affect your performance in various сhallenges.

You'll also be able to develop your character and make his equipment better. Customize your base, where you will rest and accumulate resources. Remember that your character is affected by many factors including weather, altitude, fatigue and hunger. You will be able to camp and rest, if delivery proves difficult and things don't go according to plan. 

[h2][b]Follow us on Discord and other social media to not miss the following videos and news about the project[/b][/h2]

https://discord.gg/Z4Bu5EBkCy

[h2][b]«Across the Wilds» on PC and consoles?[/b][/h2]
We're focused on the PC version of the game at this stage of development, and you can wishlist it on STEAM right now and join our community group. We'd like to see «Across the Wilds» appear on consoles. We will come back to this later on in the development of our project.

[h2][b]To support «Across the Wilds»[/b][/h2]
If you want to support «Across the Wilds» you only need to do one thing: tell your friends about «Across the Wilds» and add it to your wishlist! Thank you for your support!

We will continue to share with you the development news about our project, share with you the joy of creating it, and share our spirits with you! 
Thank you to all the players who enjoy our project and support us.

You can also support «Across the Wilds» by sharing our links!

See you soon!

notes.title: Across the wilds
notes.content: Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of off-road delivery of various cargoes. You will face harsh challenges, powerful off-road vehicles and many challenging tasks as a courier. Create your own business: fulfill contracts, earn rewards, upgrade your personal SUV alone or with friends.
